observations.body: God promises to gather Israel from the nations, cleanse them, replace the heart of stone, put his Spirit within them, and settle them in the land.
observations.label: Gathering, cleansing, a new heart, and Spirit are promised

observations.body: The passage presents Gathering, cleansing, giving, and causing as the scene's observable response or movement.
observations.label: Gathering, cleansing, giving, and causing

observations.body: The passage places My Spirit within you beside Gathering, cleansing, giving, and causing.
observations.label: My Spirit within you

payload.posture: Read Ezekiel 36:24–28 as one movement in Pentecost, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
